# ClipAPI

> Stop fighting TikTok blocks. One credit, one JSON transcript.

REST + MCP that turns a public short-video URL into timed transcript JSON and lists a creator's public uploads. TikTok only in production. Same envelope on every transport.

## URLs

- REST: https://api.clipapi.dev
- MCP Streamable HTTP: https://mcp.clipapi.dev/mcp
- OpenAPI: /openapi/openapi.yaml (also intended at /openapi.json)
- This file: /llms.txt
- Server card: /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

## Auth

```
Authorization: Bearer ck_live_...
Authorization: Bearer ck_test_...
```

Same key space for REST and MCP. No scopes. `ck_test_*` uses recorded fixtures and never hits live TikTok.

## MCP tools

### get_transcript

Maps to `GET /v1/transcript`. **1 credit** on success, including cache hits.

Arguments: `url` and/or `video_id` (one required), optional `platform`, `lang`, `format` (`json`).

Success payload matches REST `GET /v1/transcript`. `data.transcript[]` cues use `start` / `duration` in **seconds** (TranscriptAPI-compatible). Never invent cue lines.

### list_creator_videos

Maps to `GET /v1/creators/{handle}/videos`. **1 credit per page**.

Arguments: `handle` (with or without `@`), optional `platform`, `cursor`, `limit` (1–20, default 10).

### get_latest_videos

Maps to `GET /v1/creators/{handle}/latest`. **0 credits**.

Arguments: `handle`, optional `platform`. Last ~15 public uploads. Cache 5–15 minutes. Do not promise freshness under 60 seconds.

Search is not shipped. There is no `search_clips` tool yet.

## When not to call

- Private, deleted, or login-walled videos — expect `not_found`, never a fabricated transcript.
- You need the video file, a no-watermark MP4, or slideshow images — we do not host media.
- You need to post, DM, go live, or use shop — read-only public content only.
- You need an LLM summary on the hot path — take the transcript JSON and summarize yourself.
- Reels / Shorts — `unsupported_platform` until they pass soak. Do not advertise them.

## Errors

Same envelope as REST. `creditsCharged` is always 0 on error.

| code | HTTP | retryable |
|---|---|---|
| invalid_request | 400 | no |
| unauthorized | 401 | no |
| payment_required | 402 | no |
| not_found | 404 | no |
| no_transcript | 422 | no |
| unsupported_platform | 422 | no |
| rate_limited | 429 | yes |
| upstream_blocked | 503 | yes |
| internal | 500 | yes |

Failed / empty / blocked calls cost **0 credits**. Never invent transcript lines on `no_transcript`.

## Credits

Free: 100 once. Monthly $5 / 1,000 successful calls. Success costs 1. Failures cost 0.
